verdict.rationale: No evidence describes collection-level or org-level access controls that let a developer designate some memory as shared/team-visible while keeping other memory private per-agent or per-user; collections are described only as generic groupings of data sources. A community question directly raises unresolved RBAC concerns ('How are you planning on solving RBAC?... leaky by design'), reinforcing that no such tenancy/permission model is documented.
